34K likes, 316 comments - tarasutaria on October 2, 2026: "There’s something about a nude lip that always makes a festive look feel more elevated. I’m pairing @bobbibrownindia ‘s Luxe Lipstick in Downtown Plum with New Lip Tint Liner in Smokey Mulberry for rich colour and effortless definition — a combination I’ll be reaching for all season long.
Because when I’m dressing up, I’m Always in Luxe.

What’s your festive lip essential, tell me in the comments below!

#TaraSutariaXBobbiBrownIndia #AlwaysinLuxe".

15K likes, 285 comments - tarasutaria on September 30, 2026: "Step into the festive season with @bobbibrownindia ‘s Luxe Lipstick - skincare-infused colour, a rich satin finish and 10Hr moisture for lips that feel as beautiful as they look.
Downtown Plum is my choice when I want to feel bold, while Hibiscus lets me play with colour and embrace a softer, more playful mood.
Whatever the celebration calls for, I’m Always in Luxe! 💄".

20K likes, 219 comments - fashionablypernia on September 25, 2026: "The timeless allure of Indian fashion with Tara Sutaria. 

Introducing The Heritage Edit by Fashionably Pernia, shot in beautiful Bikaner with Bollywood’s icon of retro glamour. 

Featuring Tara Sutaria, the edit brings together exquisite couture, intricate embroidery, rich textiles and statement silhouettes styled as modern heirlooms. 

A celebration of heritage, craftsmanship and the designers shaping Indian fashion today.

The Heritage Edit is now live. Discover the full editorial with Tara on Fashionably Pernia. ✨

Jewellery @khajanchijewelspalace
Photography : @kunalgupta91
Location : @hotel_bhanwar_niwas
